description: This dataset holds the point building damage data used in the manuscript 'A Bayesian Approach for Earthquake Impact Modelling', compiled as R objects for the ODDRIN model of earthquake displacement and damage. It was published on the University of Oxford research data portal in January 2025 (three versions) by Max Anderson Loake, Hamish Patten and David Steinsaltz; the code that builds the objects is in the ODDRIN GitHub repository. It combines building damage footprints from the Copernicus Emergency Management Service and UNITAR/UNOSAT with building locations from Microsoft's Global ML Building Footprints, ShakeMap ground shaking, a global Vs30 map, the GEM seismic hazard map for earthquake frequency, WorldPop population, the Subnational Human Development Database and the World Inequality Database. Coverage: past earthquakes with mapped building damage worldwide. Access: a 6.2 MB download from the Oxford portal. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the files are R objects meant for the ODDRIN workflow, and source layers carry their own terms. Simulation uses: calibrating and validating building damage models against observed damage for rapid earthquake impact estimates. Related records: the STEER reconnaissance series and the EEFIT Amatrice collection.
